Messages.Author: floppyzedolfin
Messages.Body:
Hi

Jalan is in combat.

Some agg damage are inflicted to him in a step (before range, via Domain of Evernight + Outside the Hourglass for instance). He uses his special ability to treat it as normal.
(a) Later this round (in strike resolution of this round, for instance) , he gets inflicted some agg (Ivory Bow, ...). Does he still treat the agg as normal at this point of the round?
(b) In strike resolution of the next round, he gets inflicted some agg dammage. Does he still treat these damage as normal?

Thanks (and a happy new year to you all :-) )
Pascal

~~

Jalan-Aajav
Cardtype: 	Vampire
Clan: 	Gangrel antitribu
Group: 	3
Capacity: 	9
Discipline: 	ani CEL FOR POT PRO
Sabbat. Black Hand Seraph: Once each round, Jalan may burn 1 blood to treat aggravated damage as normal. He gets 1 optional press each combat.

Messages.Author: TheLasombra
Messages.Body:
a) No.
b) No.

Jalan-Aajav's ability is not a permanent effect that lasts for an entire combat (or even the entire round).  When Jalan-Aajav is receiving aggravated damage, he can treat that damage as normal damage.  The effect ends immediately upon resolution of that damage.  The next time Jalan-Aajav takes aggravated damage that round, he will not be able to burn blood to treat it as normal and he will be wounded unless he prevents the damage.

Compare to Skin of Night (@for) for the text required to do what you want in A.

Skin of Night
Combat
Fortitude
[for] This vampire treats aggravated damage as normal damage for the remainder of this round.
[FOR] As above, and prevent 1 damage.

To treat aggravated damage as normal for any longer than a round, the effect must specify it that way or be an action card that is permanently in play, like Armor of Terra or Heart of Darkness.

Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson (Rulemonger)
Messages.Body:
a) Yes.
b) No.

Combat effects last for the duration of the round, by default.
